title: 环和杆
summary: 字符串每两字符表示颜色环套在杆编号上，统计同时拥有红绿蓝三色环的杆数。
insight: 为十根杆维护三位颜色掩码，读每对字符设置对应位，最终掩码等于七的杆即三色齐全。

solutions.title: 杆颜色位掩码
solutions.idea: 三位二进制记录每根杆已有颜色。
steps: i 每次加二，color 映射 1/2/4，rod=rings[i+1]-0

code.java: class Solution { public int countPoints(String rings){int[] mask=new int[10];for(int i=0;i<rings.length();i+=2){int bit=rings.charAt(i)=='R'?1:rings.charAt(i)=='G'?2:4;mask[rings.charAt(i+1)-'0']|=bit;}int answer=0;for(int value:mask)if(value==7)answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countPoints(rings:String):Int{val mask=IntArray(10);for(i in rings.indices step 2){val bit=when(rings[i]){'R'->1;'G'->2;else->4};val rod=rings[i+1]-'0';mask[rod]=mask[rod] or bit};return mask.count{it==7}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countPoints(string rings){int mask[10]={};for(int i=0;i<(int)rings.size();i+=2){int bit=rings[i]=='R'?1:rings[i]=='G'?2:4;mask[rings[i+1]-'0']|=bit;}return count(mask,mask+10,7);} };
